$comment: Known-violations allowlist for the axe baseline-ratchet gate (rule-id level). Each entry is deferred AA work with a milestone, not an accepted defect — the list only shrinks. The gate fails on any violation whose rule id is NOT here. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-0.7.10-editor-boundary-hardening-design.md.

allow.reason: Dimmed inline markers, code-block syntax tokens, and link colors are consumer-theme-owned; the editor does not own its CSS vars yet, so contrast can't be fixed here.

Editable blocks (role=textbox: paragraphs, headings, code) have no accessible name. The per-block naming model is a consequence of the editor-root a11y-structure decision and is best settled against the integrated surface where focus/navigation semantics are real.

The thematic break uses a focusable role=separator, which axe treats as a slider-style separator requiring aria-valuenow/min/max. The focusable-separator semantics need rework (likely a different role or a non-focusable treatment).
